indications: Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules are indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) [see Clinical Studies (14)]. Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules are not indicated for the treatment of hypertension.
contraindications: Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules are indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) [see Clinical Studies (14)]. Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules are not indicated for the treatment of hypertension.
warningsAndPrecautions:
Tamsulosin Hydrochloride Capsules USP, 0.4 mg are olive green opaque/orange opaque size ‘0’ hard gelatin capsules imprinted with ‘D’ on cap and ‘53’ on body with black edible ink filled with white to off-white beadlets. 
  
                     
      Bottles of 100                               
  
      Bottles of 500                                 
  
      3 x 10 Unit-dose Capsules              
  
                     
Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature]. Preserve in tight container. Avoid excessive moisture.
  
                     
Keep tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules and all medicines out of reach of children.
adverseReactions: Tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules are contraindicated in patients known to be hypersensitive to tamsulosin hydrochloride or any component of tamsulosin hydrochloride capsules. Reactions have included skin rash, urticaria, pruritus, angioedema, and respiratory symptoms [see Adverse Reactions (6.2)].
